description: RC-L1: lever 1, budgeted cell shading (cellShading 'budget', id Tech 8's way) against Capsaicin's per-hit shading at 1280x720. (1) With a budget above the cells in use, max age 1 and one sample, the converged mean interpolated and denoised E on cornell-box, two-room and sponza (frames 301-332 from an empty cache) within 3% of perHit's, flicker before and after the denoiser beside perHit's, no NaN or negative pixels. (2) On the sunlit corner with budget 5,000 and 3 samples, lit cells = min(budget, cells in use) and shadow rays = lit x 3 exactly, and the cells lit are the CPU twin's choice by age class; again above the cells in use. (3) Lag on two-room (perHit, budget 1, 1/4, 1/16 of the cells in use): frames until the mean E is within 10% of converged after the lamp turns on and after a cut to the second bookmark, as information.
